title: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
goal: 400 points: the treasures below, and the secret of the Wizard of Frobozz
intro: You're playing Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz, the sequel to Zork I, with your Zork II tools. You start inside a barrow with an Elvish sword and a brass lantern on the ground. 400 points is a perfect score. Explore, pick up anything useful, read what you find, and keep your light on underground. The Wizard of Frobozz lives down here.
feel: the Wizard is unsettling; treasure is exciting
